# Redpoint Home Solutions

> A home buyer for the Denver metro, Colorado, for owners in difficult situations: inherited property, divorce, tax liens, code violations, major repairs, or a move they didn't plan. Backed by Onsight Construction, a licensed general contractor with 15+ years in Colorado, so offers are based on actual repair costs and current market value, and the math is shown to the seller. Zero fees, zero commissions, and zero closing costs on the seller's end. Every guide explains the owner's real options, including the ones that don't involve selling to us. Phone: (720) 738-7998.

## Situations — guides to your real options
- [Inherited a House in Colorado](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/situations/inherited-property): You inherited a property and don't know what to do. Probate, your options for selling, and shared ownership — all specific to Colorado.
- [Selling Your House During Divorce in Colorado](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/situations/divorce): Colorado's equitable distribution laws, your options, and how to sell fast with zero drama.
- [Tax Liens or Back Taxes on a Colorado Home](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/situations/tax-liens): The timeline, your rights, and your options to protect your equity before it's too late.
- [Code Violations or Major Repairs](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/situations/code-violations): What makes a home feel unsellable, and the real options. We're licensed contractors who buy houses in any condition.
- [Need to Sell Fast — Job Relocation & Life Changes](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/situations/forced-move): We close on your timeline — as quickly as 7 days.

## How selling works
- [Home](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/): Every situation in one place, with the questions sellers ask — fees, condition, closing date — answered plainly.
- [Sell Your House — Any Situation](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/sell): A calm, no-pressure way to think through what to do with a property, including options that don't involve selling to us.
- [Private Sale in Broomfield](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/private-sale): For owners open to the right offer. No sign in the yard, no showings, no repairs, and you choose the closing date.
- [About](https://redpointhomesolutions.com/about): Who we are and how our offers are built. What we tell you is what happens.
